title: HCP — Common definitions
description: Common value shapes of the Human Context Protocol (HCP) 2.0-draft-3, shared by the hcp/* tasks. Written for this registry from the HCP 2.0-draft-3 specification text (CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/loyalagents/hcp-spec), with attribution; not copied from HCP's own schema files. Where this schema and the HCP text differ, the HCP text governs.

Urn.description: An HCP identifier: a UUID in `urn:uuid:` form, as HCP uses for entry identifiers, grant identifiers and retrieval identifiers.

Category.description: An HCP context category (HCP 4.5), the primary unit of access control: either a name from HCP's category registry, such as `general_preferences` or `health_context`, or a custom category written as an absolute URI. A custom category is not portable between providers without bilateral agreement (HCP 4.5).

PurposeCode.description: An HCP purpose code: an absolute URI naming the purpose for which context is requested or may be used.
